statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-40467 is a use-after-free in gawk's do_getline_redir() (io.c): the redirection expression was released before is_non_fatal_redirect() read its name on the two-way pipe NONFATAL path. Debian's tracker names upstream commit a2d18c74 as the fix, which keeps the expression until after those reads and releases it on each return path (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-40467, https://cgit.git.savannah.gnu.org/cgit/gawk.git/commit/?id=a2d18c74109e41bec29a23098eba2e00057286d8). DHI gawk for Alpine 3.23 packages gawk 5.3.2 and has three builds published by 2026-11-28: 5.3.2-r2, 5.3.2-r3 and 5.3.2-r4, each for x86_64 and aarch64. 5.3.2-r4 is the first build that carries a backport of that commit to 5.3.2. We disassembled usr/bin/gawk in all six builds: in 5.3.2-r2 and 5.3.2-r3, do_getline_redir() releases the expression right after redirect() returns, before is_non_fatal_redirect() reads it; in 5.3.2-r4 it is released only after that read, on each return path and before the fatal error. 5.3.2-r3 was built without the backport and reads as affected.
